items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (getEncryptor, flushChunk, decodeKey, KeySourceEnv). The package doc comment lays out the stream format. The closer-ordering comment explains a non-obvious constraint, and doc comments sit on the public API. Formatting matches the repo.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The structure is sound, but validation runs twice: getEncryptor calls job.Encryption.Validate() and then LoadKey validates again. LoadKey is tied to the Enabled flag (`return nil, errors.New("encryption is not enabled")`). It uses argon2 instead of the specified pbkdf2.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w and ErrInvalidKey. The writer keeps its first error, and Close is idempotent. The key is copied defensively, key and salt lengths are checked, and constants are named (MinSaltSize, maxChunkLen). Nothing is silently swallowed.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The mandated fileutil and handler signature changes are done and callers updated; unencrypted output is unchanged. But storage.PathGenerator was left as is and hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)`, so its callers cannot ask for .enc names. It works, but awkwardly.

validity_flags.basis: existing test lines changed/removed (4): fileutil/fileutil_test.go; existing test lines changed/removed (2): handler/jobhandler_test.go
